messages:
laura.partnerships: Quick thread to align on tenant activation + pricing lines for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Partner preview in 10 days. Need final publisher ids, trial UX (cc vs no-cc), and a short billing line for the listing.

diego.legal: For tenant activation: Azure requires verified publisher tenant before we can publish private plans. I can chase the portal contact. On trial CC: No-CC okay if we add an abuse cap and billing opt-in prompt before trial expiry. I'll draft the short clause.

rana.product: Proposed billing line for listing: "14-day trial, then metered at $0.00035 per token unit (10k tokens = $3.50)". For enterprise SKU, list: "Monthly subscription + overage metered by tokens". Keeping one-line pricing helps the marketplace UI.

sam.ops: Publisher IDs: AWS sandbox ID = RBW-AWS-SBX-26 (verified), GCP publisher pending, Azure awaiting tenant verification (pinged MS contact). I'll upload marketplace manifest to sandbox tonight. Example manifest snippet I used: `{"offerId":"redwood-inference-v1","skus":["redwood-saas-standard"]}`.

marketing-bot: Asset checklist: hero (1200x400), 10s demo gif, 60-char headline. Suggested headline: "Serve LLMs with predictable latency + cost". Upload link: https://assets.redwood/marketplace/drafts/1767001234.

laura.partnerships: Action items: 1) @diego.legal finalize short trial clause + localized T&Cs (EN/DE/FR) by Thu EOD. 2) @rana.product confirm final billing line and SKU slugs by Wed. 3) @sam.ops finish AWS sandbox upload and share manifest diff by Tue midnight. 4) Marketing -> upload hero + GIF by Fri. Follow-up sync Fri 10am PT in #partnerships.

diego.legal: Will upload T&C v1 and the trial clause to the drive (link incoming). Also adding DPA link for EU listings.

rana.product: I'll lock SKU names and push PR with quickstart curl examples today.

sam.ops: Upload scheduled at 23:00 PT. Will paste results and any errors here.

laura.partnerships: Thanks all. If Azure tenant lands earlier, I'll take publisher activation. :rocket:
